derivation: Bounded wasm-bindgen wrapper around backhand's FilesystemReader APIs (FilesystemReaderTrait) exposing squashfs_list and squashfs_extract. Vendored at the pinned commit by script/import-upstream.sh with patches/0001-wasm-osstr.patch (wasm32 OsStr fallback). backhand features: gzip, lz4, v3 only; xz/zstd (C-backed), lzo and v3_lzma/v4_lzma (GPL) intentionally disabled.
